```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
export class AgentAuthorityFence {
  constructor(
    credential: AgentAuthorityCredentialInput,
    options?: AgentAuthorityFenceOptions,
  );
  readonly hasDurableCustody: boolean;
  readonly authority: AgentDurableAuthority;
  readonly authorityDescriptor: AgentAuthorityDescriptor | null;
  /** Durable-custody terminal-ledger inspection (diagnostic surface). */
  inspectCustody(): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
  /** Throws when custody is not synchronized for publication. */
  capture(): AgentAuthorityCapture;
  synchronize(): Promise<AgentAuthorityCapture>;
  isCurrent(capture: AgentAuthorityCapture | null | undefined): boolean;
  /** Throws when `capture` is stale. */
  credentialFor(capture: AgentAuthorityCapture): AgentCredentialOffer;
  credentialOfferForHandshake(): AgentCredentialOffer;
  credentialOfferForReplacement(
    credential: AgentAuthorityCredentialInput,
  ): AgentCredentialReplacementOffer;
  synchronizeValidated(
    descriptor: AgentAuthorityDescriptor,
  ): Promise<AgentAuthorityCapture>;
  bindHandshake(
    capture: AgentAuthorityCapture,
    descriptor: AgentAuthorityDescriptor,
  ): AgentAuthorityCapture;
  /** Always throws: credential replacement requires server validation
   * (use `replaceCredentialValidated`). */
  replaceCredential(): never;
  replaceCredentialValidated(
    expected: AgentAuthorityCapture,
    credential: AgentAuthorityCredentialInput,
    descriptor: AgentAuthorityDescriptor,
  ): Promise<AgentAuthorityCapture>;
  terminateValidatedCredential(
    offer: AgentCredentialOffer,
    disposition?: AgentTerminationDisposition,
  ): AgentTerminalHandle | false;
  terminate(
    capture: AgentAuthorityCapture | null | undefined,
    disposition?: AgentTerminationDisposition,
  ): AgentTerminalHandle | false;
  /** The commit callback must be synchronous; it runs only while `capture`
   * is still current (and, under durable custody, while the durable record
   * still matches). */
  compareAndCommit<T>(
    capture: AgentAuthorityCapture | null | undefined,
    commit: (
      context: AgentAuthorityCapture &
        Readonly<{ authorityDescriptor: AgentAuthorityDescriptor | null }>,
    ) => T,
  ): Promise<{ committed: false } | { committed: true; value: T }>;
  /** Returns the unregister function. */
  registerParticipant(participant: AgentAuthorityParticipant): () => Promise<void>;
}
```

Stable identity: `npm:@expo/snapback-client#AuthTerminalStatus`
Kind: `type-interface`
Source: `packages/snapback-client/index.d.mts:1544`

Terminal-auth fact (0137 A6 f3): pure projection of the client's own
terminal custody cut. `terminated: true` means this client's current
authority is permanently done (for example SNAPBACK_AUTH_STREAM_RESET
after a receipted reset-install) — retries will not reconnect; rebuild
the session. Cleared by an explicit custody replacement.

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"

  readonly code: string | null;

  readonly atMs: number | null;
}
```

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
export interface LiveQueryHandle<Rows> {
  subscriptionId: string | null;
  version: number;
  /** Wall-clock time of the most recent authoritative delivery. */
  readonly lastDeliveryAtMs: number | null;
  /** Storage commit version of the most recent authoritative delivery. */
  readonly authoritativeRevision: number;
  /** Client-clock lag for the most recent locally observed covered commit. */
  readonly deliveryLagMs: number | null;
  /** Headless has no consumer-value suppression layer; provider projections may. */
  readonly suppressedEqualSnapshots: number;
  rows: Rows;
  /** Canonical server/retained rows before generated private layers. */
  readonly authoritativeRows: Rows;
  /** Inspectable generated prediction or honest pending-without-prediction. */
  readonly optimisticPresentation: GeneratedOptimisticPresentation;
  /** Presentation authority axis. `optimistic` means `rows` includes private
   * prediction even when the canonical base freshness is `current`. */
  readonly answerClass:
    | 'unknown'
    | 'labeled-retained'
    | 'authoritative'
    | 'optimistic'
    | 'pending-without-prediction';
  /** Canonical base answer class before generated private layers. */
  readonly authoritativeAnswerClass: 'unknown' | 'labeled-retained' | 'authoritative';
  readonly connection: 'connecting' | 'live' | 'polling' | 'stale' | 'disconnected';
  readonly paused: boolean;
  /** Deterministic live re-query refusal; cleared by the next authoritative snapshot. */
  readonly refusal: SnapbackDiagnostic | null;
  /** Denial fact; null while the presented authority is not refused. */
  readonly authorizationDenial: LiveQueryAuthorizationDenial | null;
  /** Channel B freshness (LLP 0090 D1): rows from persistence/preload are
   * 'retained' until an authoritative answer makes them 'current'; null
   * while nothing authoritative-or-retained is held. */
  readonly freshness: 'retained' | 'current' | null;
  /** Retainability fact; null until the first subscribe classifies it. */
  readonly retention: LiveQueryRetention | null;
  /** Pending queued intents at retained-seed time (LLP 0090 D3 dated note,
   * 2026-08-01): non-zero means the retained rows are pre-intent. The live
   * queue state is `client.outboxStatus()`, not this boot-scoped fact. */
  readonly pendingIntentsAtSeed: number;
  poll(): Promise<Rows>;
  pause(): Promise<void>;
  resume(): Promise<void>;
  /** The sole server-side-retirement await for this handle. Local teardown is
   * synchronous; typed ownership, session, and network failures reject this
   * task. UI unmount code may ignore the returned task. */
  dispose(): Promise<void>;
  /** Drains the fresh-subscribe tail, pause release, and best-effort cleanup
   * tail. Does not await disposal; await dispose() for server retirement. */
  settled(): Promise<void>;
  flushResumeState(): Promise<void>;
}
```

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
export interface OutboxStatus {
  readonly supported: boolean;
  readonly pending: number;
  readonly failed: number;
  /** Same-principal predecessor intents held across an authority-instance cut. */
  readonly stranded: number;
  /** Upgrade-incompatible intents held for explicit successor re-entry. */

  /** Outcome-known operations whose retained result payload is gone. These

  readonly drainMode: 'auto' | 'manual' | 'none';
  readonly oldestPendingAtMs: number | null;
  readonly drainPhase: OutboxDrainPhase;
  readonly lastAttemptAtMs: number | null;
  readonly nextRetryAtMs: number | null;
  readonly blockedReason: string | null;
  /** Latest process-local rule-(a) inspect unavailability; durable capability
   * facts remain in store custody and are intentionally not projected here. */
  readonly offlineMutationReplayInspection?: Readonly<{
    readonly status: 'unavailable';
    readonly reason: string;
    readonly code: string | null;
    readonly httpStatus: number | null;
  }>;
}
```

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
    options?: Readonly<{ lane?: 'foreground' | 'housekeeping' | null }>,

  /** Read the current target-bound replay-capability fact shared by clients. */

  /** Compare and commit an answered target-capability observation. */

  outboxAcknowledgeAuthorizationResolution(
    resolution: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,

  outboxRetireAuthorizationScopes(

  /** Payload-free enqueue-target evidence for target-fenced quarantine
```

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
export interface SnapbackAuthFacade {
  currentPrincipal(): CurrentPrincipalSnapshot;
  subscribeCurrentPrincipal(listener: () => void): () => void;
  readonly enterAsGuest: SnapbackClient['authEnterAsGuest'];
  readonly claimGuestWithPassword: SnapbackClient['authClaimGuestWithPassword'];

  /**
   * One stable call for every declared provider and every Adapter.
   *
   * The Adapter is resolved once when this client is constructed and frozen for
   * its lifetime. An Adapter failure — cancellation, timeout, `invalid_client`,
   * a token refusal — is the result of this call. It never opens a different
   * Adapter, because that would change the consent brand, the provider
   * installation, and possibly the identity realm without the caller asking.
   */
  signIn(input: Readonly<{ provider: AuthIdentityProvider }>): ReturnType<SnapbackClient['authExchange']>;
  /** The resolved entry for one provider, or null when this client carries no Adapters. */
  providerEntry(provider: AuthIdentityProvider): ResolvedProviderEntryV1 | null;
  readonly signInWithExternalCode: SnapbackClient['authExchange'];
  readonly consumeRecoveryCode: SnapbackClient['authRecoveryConsume'];
  readonly rotateRecoveryCodes: SnapbackClient['authRecoveryRotate'];
  readonly changePassword: SnapbackClient['authPasswordChange'];
  readonly signOut: SnapbackClient['authLogout'];
}
```

```ts fragment reason="generated declaration projection; canonical bytes live in registry.json"
   * A generated local-executable mutation composes with the durable outbox when
```
